CONFORMS (kb/Work PB5810 landing, 2026-11-16): the RECORD clause's DEPENDING ON data-name-1 now refuses an item subject to an OCCURS clause (COBOL2270, §2023:8.4.2.3.3 SR5; §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.3 SR4 below 2002) for an indexed, relative and sort-merge file description alike (FileControlBinder.Resolve.cs#ScreenRecordDependingOccurs), where it used to compile and ignore the length register; witnesses conformance:cases/13.18.43-RECORD/pb5810-record-depending-table-element-indexed (refused at all four editions) and pb5810_record_depending_elementary_relative (accepted). The earlier PARTIAL account named that mechanism alone. || Three printed formats: F1 RECORD [CONTAINS] integer-1 [BYTES|CHARACTERS]; F2 RECORD [IS] VARYING [IN] [SIZE] [[FROM] integer-2] [TO integer-3] [BYTES|CHARACTERS] [DEPENDING [ON] data-name-1]; F3 RECORD [CONTAINS] integer-4 TO integer-5 [BYTES|CHARACTERS]. Grammar alt 1 `RECORD CONTAINS? integerLiteral (TO integerLiteral)? (CHARACTERS|BYTES)?` covers F1+F3 (TO required in F3, optional word CONTAINS), alt 2 covers F2 with every optional word optional and DEPENDING ON as its own bracket. BYTES/CHARACTERS braces: all words unmarked, so the whole group is optional - grammar matches. Probed (probe/record-clause/fm.cob) at --std 2014 and 2023: `RECORD 20`, `RECORD 5 TO 20`, `RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE TO 20 CHARACTERS`, `RECORD IS VARYING FROM 5` compile clean at both; `RECORD CONTAINS 20 BYTES` and `RECORD VARYING 5 TO 20 BYTES DEPENDING L` compile at 2023 and draw COBOL0900 at 2014 (BYTES is the 2023 addition). VARYING compiles at --std 85 (probe/record-clause/p3.cob) - correct: the 1985 RECORD clause had the VARYING format (note: docs/FILES_DESIGN.md ~L2108 claims VARYING is a 2002 introduction rejected at 85; that doc text is stale, the code is right). || Editions (adjudicator's statement, normalized to 85,2002,2014,2023 by registrar 14e): 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (BYTES spelling 2023 only - Annex E.3.3 item 13)
